svg.text: THREE THUMB SHAPES; MD / SM CROSS-SECTIONS.
HORIZONTAL WIDTH AND VERTICAL HEIGHT: CALLER.
SINGLE BAR: FILL EDGE REPRESENTS VALUE.
RANGE / ROUND THUMBS USE INSET CENTRE TRAVEL.
PAINTED THUMB AND HIDDEN INPUT ARE SEPARATE.
RANGE GESTURE OWNS SPACE BETWEEN PAINTED HANDLES.
VERTICAL PAINT ROTATES −90°; INPUT STAYS VERTICAL.
MINIMUM AT BOTTOM; RTL MIRRORS HORIZONTAL ONLY.
INLINE LABEL ONLY ON HORIZONTAL BAR.
THUMB DIMS NEAR TEXT; CONTENT WIDTH IS HUG / FLEX.
TICKS: HIDE ABOVE 50 STEPS; NONE ON KNOB.
BAR TICKS APPEAR DURING HOVER, DRAG OR FOCUS.

g.text: CIRCLE / MD · SELECTION SPAN IS VARIABLE
MD · DASHED BOX IS CONTROL, NOT A VISIBLE SURFACE
INTERIOR RANGE FILL: C(p₀) − I TO C(p₁) + I; CLAMP TO RAIL.
FIRST / LAST TICK FIELD INTERPOLATES CONTINUOUSLY TO THE RAIL EDGE.

svg.text: ACTUAL OUTER EXTENT INCLUDES THE SCALED CAPS.
HATCH: HIDDEN HIT BOX; NOT CENTRED ON PAINT IN FADER MODE.
S5 GAP BETWEEN LABEL AND READOUT.
NO DODGE AT THE TWO TRAVEL ENDPOINTS.
LAYER SEPARATION SCHEMATIC · RAIL EDGE OMITTED
SEPARATION SHOWS OWNERSHIP, NOT CSS Z-INDEX.
OPTIONAL INLINE SLOTS PAINT ABOVE THE THUMB.
